Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Pasadena for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (A Christmas Together) through December 19 (Christmas at the Museum Open House at Pasadena Heritage Park and Museum), with December 5 (Holiday Lighted Parade), December 6 (Christmas by the Bayou at Armand Bayou Nature Center) and December 4 (free Santa photos at A Christmas Together) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Pasadena

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Pasadena
  • 3 free events, including A Christmas Together, the Holiday Lighted Parade and Christmas at the Museum Open House
  • Meet Santa: free Santa photos at A Christmas Together
  • Parades and tree lightings: Holiday Lighted Parade on December 5
  • Nature: Christmas by the Bayou at Armand Bayou Nature Center
  • Season: December 4 to December 19

Planning a bigger day out? Pasadena families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Houston, which covers Zoo Lights at the Houston Zoo, The Nutcracker with Houston Ballet, skating with Santa at Discovery Green and the Polar Express train ride.
